"id": "P16",
      "title": "Discover spaced paths and dispatch a literal search per file",
      "classification": "STATIC_UNEXECUTED",
      "script": "find notes -type f -name '*.txt' -exec rg -H -n -F TODO '{}' ';' | sed 's/TODO/TASK/'",
      "argv": [
        [
          "find",
          "notes",
          "-type",
          "f",
          "-name",
          "*.txt",
          "-exec",
          "rg",
          "-H",
          "-n",
          "-F",
          "TODO",
          "{}",
          ";"
        ],
        [
          "sed",
          "s/TODO/TASK/"
        ]
      ],
      "expected": {
        "kind": "result",
        "exitCode": 0,
        "stdoutBase64": "bm90ZXMvYSBiLnR4dDoxOlRBU0sgYWxwaGEKbm90ZXMvei50eHQ6MjpUQVNLIGJldGEK",
        "stderrBase64": "",
        "stageExitCodes": [
          0,
          0
        ],
        "changedFiles": {},
        "absent": [
          "unexpected"
        ]
      },
      "reason": "find sorts directory entries and dispatches a literal argv per matching file; spaces are not split; only content tokens are replaced.",
      "anchors": [
        "src/commands/text-programs/sed.ts:224,249-270,313-317,347-413",
        "src/commands/search/options.ts:92-159; src/commands/search/rg.ts:145-163; src/commands/search/output.ts:43-52",
        "src/commands/find.ts:86-109,136-160"
      ],
      "literalChildArgv": [
        [
          "rg",
          "-H",
          "-n",
          "-F",
          "TODO",
          "notes/a b.txt"
        ],
        [
          "rg",
          "-H",
          "-n",
          "-F",
          "TODO",
          "notes/z.txt"
        ]
      ],
      "childObservation": "find uses its injected aggregate executor, not guaranteed middleware child entry; no replacement handler. Verify actual child effects; no pretend context.invoke witness."

],
  "byteFields": "Canonical base64; Uint8Array at future boundary. No implicit transcoding. Script and argv are literal Unicode JSON strings, not executable test files.",
  "pathFields": "Relative to /work; nonempty; no NUL, empty path segment, dot or dotdot segments. Leading dash, whitespace, quotes and literal newlines are valid filename data.",
  "oracleContract": "Initial files and all ancestor directories plus / and /work; changedFiles replaces/adds only named regular files. All initial content not replaced stays exact; every additional path or missing initial entry fails. absent adds explicit checks, not the entire absence oracle. Initial permission bits preserved. New permissions and timestamps not claimed.",
  "stageContract": "argv is shell command source-order, not concurrent execution order. stageExitCodes parallels argv. literalChildArgv records find-selected invocations separately. A null stage status denotes thrown outcome, not exit0. ShellResult status is asserted separately.",

    "maxPacketBytes": 262144,
